question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Admiration
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Contempt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Admiration"** means a feeling of respect and warm approval. (प्रशंसा)

 
 
• **Example: **She gazed at the beautiful sunset with admiration.
 
 
 
• **"Contempt"** refers to the feeling that a person or a thing is beneath consideration, worthless, or deserving scorn. (तिरस्कार)
 
 
• **Example: **He spoke with contempt about the corruption in the government.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'admiration' **is **'contempt'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Contempt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Diminish **(कम करना): Make or become less.

 
 
• **Example:** The pain will gradually diminish in the coming weeks.
 
 
 
• **Cognisance **(ज्ञान): Knowledge, awareness, or notice.
 
 
• **Example: **The company took cognisance of the complaints and decided to take action.
 
 
 
• **Accomplish** (पूरा करना): Achieve or complete successfully.
 
 
• **Example:** They were able to accomplish the project on time.
